attempts.summary: Created a "Fleet Internal CA" on node1, issued and installed a CA-signed TLS certificate (CN=node2, SAN DNS:node2/IP:10.100.96.11) for node2, configured node2 to serve HTTPS on port 8443 with that certificate (via a systemd-managed openssl s_server unit, since no package repos were available to install httpd/nginx), opened the port in firewalld, and installed the Fleet Internal CA as a trusted system CA on both node1 and node2 via update-ca-trust. Verified trust end-to-end with curl (no -k) and openssl s_client returning Verify return code: 0. Completed the mandatory one-node-at-a-time restart protocol on both nodes, confirming changed boot IDs and full post-restart recovery of CA trust and the HTTPS service.
